summary: One-frame result of rating a mod on mod.io (client only, registry total 16). ls::PublishingSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3BDE2A0; Toolkit GameEngine.dll ls::PublishingSystem::Process*Requests) creates it on a new entity from a request queued by the matching HandleUGC... callback of the mod.io back-end; the same frame also gets a UGCRequestResultOneFrameComponent with the net::UGCResult and request Guid. Request queue filled by HandleUGCRatingSet(unsigned __int64, net::EUGCRatingOptions, net::UGCResult); drained by bg3.exe+0x3BDF220.

fields.name: ModId
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x3BE1700 (AllocRaw 0x10) zeroes the qword at +0; bg3.exe+0x3BDF220 stores the request's qword +0 (mod id) here (request stride 0x48).

fields.name: Rating
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes the byte at +8; bg3.exe+0x3BDF220 copies request byte +8 (the net::EUGCRatingOptions argument of HandleUGCRatingSet; enum written as its 1-byte integer).
